Bibhash was also a prominent figure in the Hindu reform movement of the 19th century, advocating for the revival of traditional Hindu practices and the eradication of social evils. He is known for his critical work 'Saraswati-Tilak', which challenged the prevailing orthodoxy and influenced the emergence of modern Hinduism and its intellectual discourse.
